list.title: Materials in and out
list.description: {count, plural, one {# movement} other {# movements}} matching the current filters. Seeds, clones, plants and cultures are counted; flower and trim are weighed.

stats.inTransitHint: Shipments that have left and are not yet delivered
stats.draftsHint: Recorded but not yet sent or received

list.searchPlaceholder: Reference, tracking, manifest, organization or unit
list.caption: Receipts and shipments of material
list.emptyBody: Receipts and shipments appear here once they are recorded, each against the other party’s licence.
list.noMatchBody: Try a different search or date range, or clear the filters to see everything.

timeline.title: History
timeline.empty: No history is recorded for this movement.
timeline.statusAndFields: Status changed from {from} to {to}; also updated {fields}

actions.title: Actions
actions.adminOnly: Only administrators can change a movement. You can still read every detail on this page.
actions.inTransitBody: The shipment is recorded as having left.
actions.deliveredBody: The delivery date is set to today unless one is already recorded.
actions.cancelBody: A cancelled movement moves no material and cannot be reopened. The record stays for audit.
actions.voidBody: The record is withdrawn with your reason and no longer listed. It stays in the audit trail. This cannot be undone.
actions.finished: This movement is complete and can no longer change status.
actions.leavingUnits: {count, plural, one {# unit on it is} other {# units on it are}} recorded as shipped and leave inventory. This cannot be undone.
actions.leavingBulk: Its lines are ledger entries only; no unit is affected.
actions.leavingInbound: Received material is registered as units separately.

custody.title: Custody details
custody.description: Correct the carrier, manifest and licence details. Each change is recorded in the history.

form.title: Record a material movement
form.description: Every receipt and shipment is logged against the other party’s licence, for regulatory reconciliation.
form.lockedBody: Receipts and shipments are custody records. Ask an administrator to record this one.
form.organizationRequired: Select the organization on the other end of this movement.
form.statusLeavesHint: Any status except draft records the units on this shipment as shipped now, and removes them from inventory.
form.dateHint: Optional. Leave empty to use today when the movement has already happened.
form.licenceDefault: Leave empty to use the organization’s licence, {licence}.
form.licenceHint: Licence number of the other party.
form.linesHint: Seeds, clones, plants and cultures are counted in whole units. Flower and trim are weighed in grams and need a wet or dry basis.
form.pickUnitHint: Only units that are in inventory and not on hold can be shipped.
form.fixErrors: Some information is missing or not valid. Check the fields marked with an error.
